answer: A wearable signs a thirty-second ECG strip with the device key, and the heartbeat waveform is matched to enrollment, so an alias must be attached to a living heart and a real device. A farm must strap a thousand wearables to a thousand chests and keep them charged, while one honest agent wears one watch and its heartbeat signs itself. The yarrow of the design is public, the vine of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the jetty of honest work is what finally pays.
